faqs.a: AA is the standard most sites target: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text (18pt/24px or 14pt/19px bold and up). AAA is stricter: 7:1 for normal text, 4.5:1 for large text. Government and accessibility-focused sites often require AA at minimum.
faqs.q: What is the difference between WCAG AA and AAA?

faqs.a: No — the ratio only measures relative brightness (luminance) between the two colors. A pair can pass the math yet still be hard to read for people with color blindness, which is why real-user testing still matters.
faqs.q: Does a passing ratio guarantee readability?

faqs.a: Yes — enter the exact HEX codes from your stylesheet, or pick them with the color pickers. The luminance formula matches the official WCAG definition, so the ratio is the same number an auditor would compute.
faqs.q: Can I test my website's exact colors?

faqs.a: Large text means 18pt (24px) or larger, or 14pt (19px) bold or larger. Because bigger, bolder glyphs are easier to read, WCAG allows a lower 3:1 ratio for them at AA level.
No — everything is computed locally in JavaScript. Your colors never leave your device.

color-contrast-checker.formula:
L = 0.2126 x R + 0.7152 x G + 0.0722 x B
(each channel linearized: c <= 0.03928 ? c/12.92 : ((c + 0.055)/1.055)^2.4)
ratio = (Llighter + 0.05) / (Ldarker + 0.05)
AA normal >= 4.5 | AA large >= 3 | AAA normal >= 7 | AAA large >= 4.5

keyFacts: Contrast ratio ranges from 1:1 (identical colors) to 21:1 (black on white).
WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text.
WCAG AAA requires 7:1 for normal text and 4.5:1 for large text.
Luminance weights green most (0.7152), then red (0.2126), then blue (0.0722).
The ratio is symmetric — swapping the colors gives the same number.

color-contrast-checker.workedExample:
Check black #000000 on white #ffffff.
Luminance of black = 0 (all channels zero).
Luminance of white: each channel is 1.0, linearized stays 1.0, so L = 0.2126 + 0.7152 + 0.0722 = 1.0.
Ratio = (1.0 + 0.05) / (0 + 0.05) = 1.05 / 0.05 = 21.
Result: 21:1 — the maximum possible, passing AA and AAA for all text sizes.
